fact: In its 2021-2022 annual report ARCT states it launched a public consultation on its 5G deployment roadmap so that stakeholders could give their views, and held a validation workshop at which stakeholders validated a draft ordinance on terminals connectable to networks.
title: Rapport annuel des activités réalisées au cours de l'exercice 2021-2022
publisher: Agence de Régulation et de Contrôle des Télécommunications (ARCT)
